_comment: How the people the player talks to are (see docs/modding.md, "ai"). Every mod's ai/people.json goes over the ones
before it key by key. A person is drawn one temperament the first time they are talked to, and keeps it.
words: who they are, as the AI is told ({temperament} in the chat prompts).
give: how far they come down on a price, times the rules' most for their kind (ai.talk.discount*): 0 never, 1 all of it.
for: the kinds it is drawn for (seller, salesman, rival); none is every kind. weight: how often, against the others.
minAggression, maxAggression: for rivals, drawn only for a racer's aggression (0-100) in this range.

chatty.words: Friendly and talkative, wanders off into stories about the old days, but honest.

gruff.words: Gruff and short with words, no time for small talk, hates being lowballed.

needs_cash.words: Needs the money and it shows: eager, a little nervous, wants the thing gone.

proud_owner.words: Proud of what they are selling, fussy about it, sad to let it go; won't sell it to just anybody.

widow.words: Selling it for a husband or son who is gone; knows little about engines, kind but no pushover.

shifty.words: A bit shifty: talks around the bad points without lying about them, always says it's a steal.

jive_talker.words: A fast-talking car salesman full of jive: calls everybody pal or sport, a joke a minute, never stops selling, every car is the deal of the century. Never lies about the facts, but puts the best shine on them.

smooth_operator.words: A smooth, slick salesman: easy smile, low voice, flatters the customer, makes every car sound like it was waiting for them.

old_timer.words: An old-timer salesman who has sold cars since before the war: folksy, knows every car's quirks, likes a straight talker.

hothead.words: A hothead: cocky, quick to take offence, trash-talks and dares people to race.

cool_customer.words: Cool and quiet, says little, a dry sense of humour, sizes people up.

showboat.words: A show-off who loves to brag about their car and their wins, but friendly enough.

good_sport.words: A good sport: friendly, honest about wins and losses, likes talking engines.
